test: B2 derivative markets vs the main line
runs: once, by scripts/derivs_research.py --b2, when the trigger is met; the result is written beside this file and never overwritten

trigger.game: a game with a derivative quote and a full-game fair line both standing 2 h before the start, in scripts/data/props (nfl-*.jsonl game rows, derivs-*.jsonl)

quoteFair: line + sd x zinv(p), p = (ask of the first side + 1 - ask of the second side) / 2; first side = home (1hs) or over
mainFair: Novig fair full-game margin M (home) and total T: odds_novig rows for the NFL, the ms / mt rows' m elsewhere
asOf: the rows standing 2 h before the start (lookback 7 days); last = the rows standing at the start

implied.fit: per league and market, least squares on the league's first 40% of trigger games by start time (20+ games, else the league is left out)

rows: game-markets of the remaining 60% with |quote fair - implied| >= 1.5 points 2 h before the start
score: y = -sign(dev) x (quote fair at the start - quote fair 2 h before): points the derivative moved toward the implied value
pass: mean y > 0 with t >= 2, CR1 by game day (US Eastern date of the start), one-sided, all leagues and markets pooled
reported: the same drift for quotes under 1.5 off (baseline)
share of flagged quotes that moved toward
outcome: pass = a lead for a priced test (asks, not lines); no pick and no page claim either way
priorLooks: Nov 14 2026: NFL archive, counts and dispersion of dev only (in-sample fit, no drift read)
